messages:
nina: FYI we're getting Cloudflare Pages and Vercel Edge errors after the conditional-export publish. Error: "SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export'" from users' builds.

omar: Hmm. That usually means something pulled a CJS file into an ESM runtime or vice-versa. What's our package.json right now?

li: Current simplified layout: 
```
{
  "type": "module",
  "main": "dist/cjs/index.cjs",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
      "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs"
    }
  },
  "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts"
}
```

omar: Two problems: 1) `type: module` can make some packaging tools treat root as ESM and then `main` + `require` fallback gets weird. 2) Edge runtimes expect explicit .mjs entry sometimes.

nina: We should avoid surprising runtimes. Proposal: emit explicit files and remove `type`. Use .mjs/.cjs extensions as source of truth. Provide a dedicated `/edge` subpath for edge-optimized bundle.

li: Proposed package.json snippet: 
```
{
  "main": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
      "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs"
    },
    "./edge": "./dist/esm/index.mjs"
  },
  "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts"
}
```
This keeps resolution explicit and gives users `import 'redwood-inference/edge'` if they need ESM-only path.

omar: For TypeScript: consumers still look for `.d.ts` at the package root `types` field. We can mirror types next to both builds during pack step (emit `dist/esm/index.d.ts` and `dist/cjs/index.d.ts`) and keep `types` pointing at `dist/types/index.d.ts` that re-exports the correct declarations.

nina: Also: publish `.mjs` (ESM bundle) and `.cjs` (CJS bundle) explicitly. Do not rely on `type` to indicate module flavor. That reduces bundler heuristics.

pm-bot: note: some packagers (pnpm, yarn pnp) follow `exports` strictly; ensure we include subpath entries for `./package.json` and `./package.json` if consumers read metadata.

pm-bot: recommended test matrix: node 14/16/18, webpack 5, esbuild bundling, Vercel Edge preview, wrangler preview (Cloudflare).

pm-bot: also run `npm pack` locally and test installing tarball into a clean project.

pm-bot: add a smoke test `sample-apps/edge-smoke` which imports `import { Client } from 'redwood-inference/edge'` and runs a small in-worker harness.

pm-bot: add a CI job on PRs that deploys the smoke app to a preview Edge (wrangler + vercel preview) and fails CI on runtime import errors.

li: Migration notes for users:
- If you used `require('redwood-inference')` before, keep working via `require('redwood-inference').default` or switch to `const { Client } = require('redwood-inference/cjs')`.
- For ESM/Edge, use `import { Client } from 'redwood-inference/edge'` to be explicit.

nina: I'll open a PR to change build outputs and add the smoke tests. Omar can review packaging changes.

pm-bot: reminder: update changelog and increment package version on merge, run canary publish to sample-apps.

release-bot: publish checklist: changelog, tests green, canary deploy OK, feature flag for gradual rollout.

li: One more callout: Bun/Deno may not honor node export conditions; we should document known support and link sample-apps reproductions.

omar: Agreed. Let's aim to land the packaging change + smoke CI this week so we can undeprecate the earlier release.

nina: Thanks team, will post the PR link here when ready.
